scripts.fmt: if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format .; else echo 'ruff not installed, skipping'; fi
scripts.fmt-check: if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format --check .; else echo 'ruff not installed, skipping'; fi
scripts.lint: if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check .; else echo 'ruff not installed, skipping'; fi
